comment.narrative: At a regional level

In the field of research European experts have been able to verify that there is a great lack of knowledge of some subjects especially in the field of detection of false documents money laundering and use of means of international information exchange and a high specialization in others such as cybercrime although in very specific aspects and that is why the exchange of knowledge is also necessary in this matter. It is worth highlighting the high degree of involvement and interest always shown by the participants from the three countries as well as the collaborative ties created. The project has received a very positive response in relation to subsequent exchanges of information between them.

comment.narrative: At least 1 comunication every 3 months during the last year of the project.

At the beginning of the project the longterm expert group met with counterparts and Interpols NCBs National Central Bureaus were identified as the central building blocks from which international cooperation should flow. For this purpose a series of contacts are established the formation of IWG International Working Group working groups and the appointment of contact points in the three countries. As a result of these periodic meetings the identification and need for training in a series of work areas was established as well as the need for material to implement its operational activity. All of this was complemented with study visits to Europe in this case it was to Madrid.

comment.narrative: At a regional level
At a regional lever and at least 2 summits per year

A working group is created that partly coincides with the GTI. It is about creating points of contact and coordinating knowledge and joint actions. The objective was to determine the most appropriate training activities and identify the necessary office and operational material so that it could later be provided by the project. Finally a series of internships are carried out in Spain both by the organized crime working group GTCOR and by those responsible for the training schools of the participating countries. Members of units specialized in organized crime have accompanied Interpol study visits until the quota in each case is filled.

comment.narrative: Training activities have been carried out at the request of the project stakeholders and others at the initiative of the project team based on their technical experience in all types of subjects aimed at improving capabilities for the fight against organized crime. Examples include Interpol case manager training detection of false documents cybercrime and cyber trafficking money laundering prospective intelligence detection and knowledge of new techniques for introducing drugs and weapons. It is necessary to point out that the project ended with a course on human rights and equality integrating all police knowledge under a premise of values that define the quality and degree of maturity of a police force and the institutions with which it works respecting the citizen and recognizing that they must be representation of the society they serve.
